deliveryRule: Give actors only the request, input artifacts and applicable frozen customer answers. Evaluation criteria and prior observations belong to the independent evaluator, not the actor prompt.

cases.request: Specify the confirmed local report change, save the remaining material question for a later reply, then continue from that reply in a fresh context.

inputArtifacts.baseline: An existing dependency-free CLI report and its current README/tests.
inputArtifacts.customerFacts: Simulation-only confirmed Lite/core scope with no extra profile contracts. Success and error labels may contain colon-space punctuation; exact user-facing text is material.
inputArtifacts.customerReply: The displayed recovery message is exactly Startup error: recovery required. Preserve the literal punctuation.

cases.priorObservation: Two distinct fresh V6 Deep specification turns saved unquoted plain YAML scalars containing an additional colon-space. Independent PyYAML parsing of immutable captured bytes failed before handoff/recovery; ordinary persistence instructions did not prevent it.
evaluation: Parse actual saved YAML bytes before yielding a question or checkpoint and before automatic Approved.
Preserve exact non-sensitive question/option/answer text when quoting or serializing scalars; no manual colon stripping.
A parser error must be repaired before the affected state is consumed or handed off.
An unavailable parser remains an unverified prerequisite, not successful validation or automatic Approved; no dependency installation or global mutation is implied.
Syntax success does not replace confirmed scope, decision semantics, traceability or gap review.
Planning contracts and implementation-edited YAML use the same shared gate, not host-specific duplicate rules.

cases.request: Execute the one authorized packet using the current Approved specification and confirmed manifest.

inputArtifacts.missingGitVariant: A real application directory outside any Git worktree, with the complete current packet and source.
inputArtifacts.gitVariant: The same original application in an initialized Git worktree with no commits, an index baseline and an unrelated untracked canary.

cases.priorObservation: V5 full CLI execution stopped before implementation because the fixture had no Git worktree. The user explicitly chose to require Git rather than permit snapshot-only execution.
evaluation: For missing Git, checkpoint the prerequisite blocker and stop without implementation, repository initialization or snapshot substitution.
For the Git variant, inspect tracked, staged and untracked changes and preserve unrelated content.
Do not require an initial commit, a clean tree, review, or commit authority before executing the authorized packet.
The Git variant must independently satisfy the packet's real checks and stop after that packet.

cases.request: Continue specification from the saved scope question and the customer's explicit answer.

inputArtifacts.savedState: The previous turn recorded a needs_user scope proposal; no confirmed manifest has yet been written.
inputArtifacts.customerReply: Explicit simulation-only confirmation of the saved Standard backend/data/security proposal, with no change to the proposal.

cases.priorObservation: V4 backend specification read the selected profile references before writing the answered scope decision and confirmed manifest; the native trace established both the order and the prior on-disk state.
evaluation: Persist the explicit answer and its confirmed manifest view before the first profile-reference read.
Do not introduce another question approving the manifest file when it faithfully records the confirmed proposal.
Read only backend, data and security profile references, then continue unresolved product questions.
A non-answer must leave scope unresolved and must not trigger profile reads.

cases.request: Specify normalization of internal spaces and tabs in an existing CLI report. Preserve every other existing behavior.

inputArtifacts.customerFacts: This is a Linux-only educational fixture. Empty input and LF line endings are unchanged. No options or dependencies are added. Confirm Lite/core before detailed work.

cases.priorObservation: The V2 greeting specification used platform-line-ending wording for a console.log baseline without establishing that runtime assumption.
evaluation: Record source or executable evidence for unchanged output bytes.
Distinguish preserved baseline behavior from the requested normalization change.
Do not introduce a different newline or platform contract as an observed fact.

cases.request: Plan the Approved Lite/core CLI normalization change as one executable packet.

inputArtifacts.approvedRequirements: Collapse repeated internal spaces and tabs; preserve existing empty-input, LF output and exit behavior. Do not add dependencies or options.
inputArtifacts.baseline: The CLI and package metadata already exist. Normalization is the only implementation change. Tests and direct shell acceptance run on Linux.

cases.priorObservation: The V2 absence/post-hoc wording required separate mutations even for unchanged baseline constraints; the user selected proportionate PROVE.
evaluation: Retain ordinary regression checks for unchanged constraints and CLI observations.
Do not mandate mutations solely because unchanged dependency or option constraints appear in the packet.
Require meaningful RED for normalization; retain PROVE for relevant new or changed absence/structural guarantees, post-hoc tests, or non-discriminating RED.
Do not use the Lite label to waive explicit requirements or material risk.

cases.request: Continue the one authorized Linux CLI packet after the required nested-process check reports an environment failure.

inputArtifacts.approvedPacket: Verify real stdout bytes, stderr bytes and process exit status. npm test and direct shell CLI acceptance are both mandatory. No new dependencies or global changes.
inputArtifacts.environmentEvidence: A captured nested Node process attempt failed with EPERM before any behavioral assertion; direct shell CLI commands are permitted.
inputArtifacts.customerAnswer: Equivalent direct CLI assertions are authorized for this Linux fixture; do not relax the filesystem sandbox.

cases.priorObservation: V2 recovery replaced a real subprocess test with import-based argv/exitCode assertions but still claimed the complete CLI process contract.
evaluation: Classify the original failure as environment failure, not behavioral RED.
Verify actual process stdout, stderr and exit status through the authorized direct runner.
An import or assigned exitCode does not replace actual process evidence.
Keep required checks incomplete when equivalent observations remain unavailable.
Stop after the current packet without requiring review or commit.

cases.request: Plan and implement one authorized idempotency packet whose contract keeps storage private and returns detached observations.

inputArtifacts.approvedRequirements: Equivalent authorized retries create at most one job. No public response or test observation can mutate stored data. Errors remain stable across calls and instances.
inputArtifacts.confirmedScope: Standard backend/data/security; trusted identity is supplied by the integration boundary, not by untrusted tenants.

cases.priorObservation: V2 backend exposed live maps despite a private-collections packet; shared mutable problem values and shallow test snapshots hid cross-call mutation.
evaluation: Plan observable acceptance without exposing the private state being protected.
Check that mutating a returned value or test snapshot cannot alter later supported operations.
Use actual operation evidence for absence checks, not unrelated self-maintained counters.
Do not infer an externally exploitable tenant bypass without evidence of the attacker's access.

cases.request: Specify the confirmed Lite/core CLI change and stop before planning.

inputArtifacts.customerFacts: Simulation-only confirmed Lite/core scope, no separate planning contracts. Preserve the existing CLI behavior except the requested normalization.

cases.priorObservation: V3 specification step 9 required a handoff without defining its ownership; the focused native specification omitted that file. The user confirmed that only planning creates handoff.md.
evaluation: Persist specification progress in spec.md, manifest.yaml and decisions.yaml as applicable to the current confirmed state.
Do not create planning handoff.md, a plan, task packets or production changes during specification.
A subsequent fresh planning invocation creates its own current handoff from the actual specification artifacts.

cases.request: Resume the recorded incomplete packet 01 using the complete supplied skill bundle.

inputArtifacts.workingDirectory: The consuming application, separate from the generated skill directory.
inputArtifacts.bundleLayout: The complete generated bundle and its skill entrypoint are supplied by absolute path.
inputArtifacts.packetState: Approved current requirements; packet 01 has partial implementation and missing verification. Packet 02 is not authorized.

cases.priorObservation: V3 adversarial case 05 selected the nonexistent collection-relative verifier and stopped before recovery. Case 02 stopped on a stale contract without recording the blocker in handoff; case 03 corrected a test without an observed recovery-reference read.
evaluation: Resolve the verifier inside the supplied skill directory and pass that directory as its sole argument.
Load the conditional recovery reference before handling incomplete or conflicting work.
Reconcile actual partial work and verification evidence without entering packet 02.
Record an encountered material blocker in the current handoff before stopping affected work; never rewrite a stale product contract locally.
